summary: A question opens a conversation and can test authority. In the Analects, asking is frequently part of learning.

satellites.title: To Ask About Governing
satellites.evidence: In Analects 13.1, Zilu asks about governing (問政). A question is situated in a conversation rather than a universal recipe.

satellites.title: Not Ashamed to Ask Below
satellites.evidence: Analects 5.15: Kong Wenzi earned the name 文 because he was 敏而好學，不恥下問 — “quick, fond of learning, and not ashamed to ask those beneath him.”
